summary: Tested Wallet Auto Top-Up feature with PayFast tokenization. All 15 backend tests passed. Frontend verified: Settings page shows Change Password + Wallet Auto Top-Up for job seekers, ONLY Change Password for recruiters. Sidekick panel wallet bar displays correctly with balance and top-up button.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed missing 'Response' import in server.py - ITN webhook was returning 500 error
PayFast tokenization setup correctly returns subscription_type=2 and amount=0.00 for card save
Auto top-up settings validation working: threshold 0-5000, amount 5-10000
Business logic correct: cannot enable auto top-up without saved card (returns 400)
ITN webhook is public endpoint (no auth required) - correct for PayFast callbacks
Remove card endpoint is idempotent - returns success even when no card saved
Role-based visibility correct: Wallet Auto Top-Up section only shows for job_seeker role
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wallet Auto Top-Up feature fully tested. Key findings: 1) All wallet API endpoints working: card-status, auto-topup (GET/POST), setup-card, remove-card, wallet-itn. 2) PayFast card setup returns real form data pointing to www.payfast.co.za/eng/process (LIVE mode). 3) ITN webhook at /api/payfast/wallet-itn is public (no auth). 4) Auto-topup settings stored in user.wallet_auto_topup, card token in user.wallet_payfast_token. 5) Settings page correctly shows Wallet Auto Top-Up section ONLY for job seekers. 6) Auto top-up form is greyed out when no card saved - correct UX. 7) Sidekick panel shows wallet balance and auto-topup badge (when enabled). 8) Fixed missing Response import in server.py.
